module.Title: Create a Flexible Rock List
module.Teaching: A List can grow and shrink while the game runs, making it useful for world objects.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why use a List for rocks?
PredictionOptions: Rocks can be added and removed
A List stores only one item
module.PredictionExplanation: A List supports adding and removing elements during play.
module.DebugPrompt: A generic List needs the element type inside angle brackets.
module.RecallPrompt: Create an empty List of string values named rocks.
module.TransferPrompt: Create an empty List of string values named enemies.
module.PreviewMessage: The cave can now track a flexible collection of rocks.
